messages:
sam: Quick heads-up — planning to cut release/1.12 branch tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need someone to create the branch and triage backport/cherry-pick requests.
maya: I can help with backports during the morning. Who's taking branch creation?
chris: I can cut the branch at 09:00. Want me to open the PR from main -> release/1.12?
sam: Yes please. Branch naming: release/1.12. We'll lock merges to main after cutoff (08:00 PT). Backport policy: only bugfix/security/infra fixes. Docs/upgrade notes can be deferred.
liao: For clarity, what's the process for cherry-picks? PR must include `cherry-pick: backport` label + test run, right?
sam: Correct. Require `cherry-pick/backport` label and passing CI. Also add `changelog: present` in PR body or we'll ask to add.
chris: Plan: I'll run:
```
git checkout -b release/1.12 origin/main
git push origin release/1.12
```
then open PR to create the branch in the repo and assign @release-manager.
release-manager: Got it, I'll review the branch PR and add the release checklist.
maya: Quick ask — PR #4862 needs a backport for a regression. @chris can you review the cherry-pick PR when ready? Link: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4862
chris: Yep will queue it after branch PR. If anyone needs emergency exception after cutoff, ping me + @release-manager with the label `emergency-backport` and rationale.
deploy-bot: CI scheduled for branch creation PR — job: `branch-create` queued.
sam: Changelog reminder: please add a one-liner under `Unreleased` and tag with `changelog: yes`. We'll compile final CHANGELOG at 14:00 PT the day of release.
maya: Noted. Also can we freeze infra migrations? I will hold DB migration PRs until after the cut unless it's critical.
sam: Agreed. Migrations require explicit approval from infra team.
chris: Branch PR created: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4900 — I'll set the assignees and add the `release/1.12` label.
maya: :thumbsup: thanks chris.
release-manager: I'll produce release notes draft after we've collected changelog entries. Folks, please add short descriptions to your PRs.
sam: Thanks everyone. If there's no objection, cutting at 09:00 PT tomorrow. I'll post a final reminder one hour before cutoff.
chris: Sounds good.
maya: Ready.
liao: Ready.
